## The 1.0 train

AgentWorks BOM 1.22.0 is the first BOM in which every AgentWorks member ships a 1.0 or later release. It is also the first
in which **Agent Client has no Spring AI dependency**: `agent-client-core` is framework-free, and Spring Boot, Quarkus
and Micronaut each get their own integration module. Agent Journal moves to 2.0, a clean break that records agent runs
in the 1.0.0 formats, and Agent Judge ships 1.0 under its new name, **Agent Eval**.

### What moves

| Member | 1.21.0 | 1.22.0 | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent-client` | 0.31.0 | **1.0.0** | Spring-free core with its own `Ordered`; no `org.springframework.ai` artifact on any module's classpath. New `agent-client-spring-boot-autoconfigure`, `agent-client-quarkus` (+ `-deployment`) and `agent-client-micronaut`. Lifecycle provider modules for Claude, Codex, Antigravity and Junie; Journal 2.0 recording through `agent-client-journal` |
| `agent-journal` | 1.10.1 | **2.0.0** | Clean break: `journal-capture-tck` and `journal-ocsf-writer` read and write only the 1.0.0 formats. Adds the Junie ACP acquisition qualifier |
| `agent-judge`, now **Agent Eval** | 0.17.0 | **1.0.0** | The repository, groupId, artifact IDs and Java packages keep the `agent-judge` name |
| `agent-workflow` | 0.12.3 | **1.1.0** | Spring Boot, Quarkus and Micronaut modules; `workflow-agent-client` runs an Agent Client as a Workflow agent; the jsoup security fix (below) |
| `claude-code-sdk` | 1.7.0 | **1.8.0** | Corrected wire form for a hook's PreToolUse Block and Modify; process and protocol handling verified against a real Claude CLI |
| `agent-hooks` | 0.8.3 | **1.0.0** | On SDK 1.8.0, so a Modify hook now rewrites the tool input (on 1.7.0 the original command ran) |
| `agent-sandbox` | 0.10.2 | **1.0.0** | API unchanged from 0.10.2; Jackson 2.22.3 |
| `agent-memory` | 0.5.1 | **1.0.0** | API unchanged from 0.5.1; Jackson 2.22.3 and 3.2.3 |
| `agent-bench` | 0.6.3 | **1.0.0** | On Client 1.0.0 and Agent Eval 1.0.0 |
| `agent-experiment` | 0.9.0 | **1.0.0** | On Client 1.0.0, Journal 2.0.0, Agent Eval 1.0.0 and Workflow 1.1.0 |
| `acp-java-sdk` | 0.17.0 | **0.81.0** | `acp-websocket-jetty` is no longer published and leaves the BOM |

Journal 1.x stays managed at **1.11.0** (`journal-core` and the `*-cli-capture` modules). Client's Codex, Grok, Junie and
Antigravity providers and Workflow's `workflow-journal` still use it. A later BOM drops it once they move to Journal 2.

### Security

- **CVE-2026-75140** (HIGH) and **CVE-2026-71497** (MEDIUM) in `org.jsoup:jsoup`. `workflow-agents` reached jsoup 1.15.4
  through `spring-ai-agent-utils`' web-fetch tool. Workflow 1.1.0 declares jsoup 1.24.1 directly, so applications on
  this BOM resolve the patched version. Workflow 1.0.0 shipped with the finding recorded and the fix deferred to 1.1.0.
  Use 1.1.0.
- **Jackson floor.** The Quarkus 3.40 and Micronaut 4.10 platform BOMs manage Jackson 2.21.6, which has known HIGH
  findings. The AgentWorks framework modules import `jackson-bom` 2.22.3 first. If you also import a platform BOM,
  import AgentWorks before it.

### Managed coordinates

The BOM manages **110 AgentWorks and ACP coordinates, up from 76**. The additions are the framework modules above,
`workflow-agent-client`, `agent-client-junie`, the Journal 2 modules, the remaining Agent Eval and Client modules, and
every member's parent POM. Two coordinates are removed: `acp-websocket-jetty`, which is no longer published, and
`workflow-temporal`, which no current Workflow release builds.

### One dependency graph, no cycles

The members now form one acyclic layering:
- SDK, Sandbox, Memory and Journal 1.x;
- Hooks and Journal 2;
- Client;
- Agent Eval;
- Workflow;
- Experiment and Bench.

Every member's dependencies point downward, in every scope, including tests.

### Upgrading

```xml
<dependencyManagement>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>io.github.markpollack</groupId>
      <artifactId>agentworks-bom</artifactId>
      <version>1.22.0</version>
      <type>pom</type>
      <scope>import</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
</dependencyManagement>
```

Then declare AgentWorks dependencies without versions. Client 1.0.0 removes the Spring AI interfaces from `AgentOptions`,
`AgentResponse` and related types; every method stays. Code that typed them as Spring AI interfaces needs a source
update. See Agent Client's `RELEASE_NOTES_1.0.0.md` for the full list.
